name: LightCraft
description: LightCraft is an open-source, non-destructive photo editor written from scratch in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team, covering photo library management and raw development. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) and also runs on Windows and Linux. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast: v0.10.0 landed in October 2026.

zh.tagline: 照片图库与 Raw 冲印。
zh.description: LightCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队从零开始、用纯 Rust 编写的开源非破坏性照片编辑器，覆盖图库管理与 Raw 冲印。提供 macOS universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时支持 Windows 和 Linux。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快：v0.10.0 于 2026 年 10 月发布。
